blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built from the boards' September 2026 statistics, the monthly SnapStats figures and Jared's MLS® closed sales (Nov 2025 to Oct 2026). No live feed filtered to this home type yet.

Mission acreages for sale: houses and land on lots of one acre or more. The Fraser Valley Real Estate Board benchmark for a detached house in Mission was $889,200 in September 2026. Jared sets up a search for the size, area and use you want, and checks whether the land is in the ALR before you offer.
Mission houses with acreage sold, November 2025 to October 2026

76 houses with acreage sold in Mission with a median price of $1,400,500 (the middle half sold between $1,168,750 and $1,590,625), taking a median of 48 days to sell at 95.6% of the last list price; 9% sold above list. They had a median year built of 1990 and a median lot of 3.9 acres.

Longer term, over 3 years it fell 14.2%; over 5 years it fell 10.6%.

blocks.text: Before you buy acreages in Mission
Jared checks these with you on the exact address before you write an offer:

faq.q: What did acreages in Mission sell for?
faq.a: 76 houses with acreage sold in Mission between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,400,500.

faq.q: How long do acreages take to sell in Mission?
faq.a: The median was 48 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 95.6% of the last list price (9% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most acreages in Mission sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 76 houses with acreage that sold in Mission went for between $1,168,750 and $1,590,625, around a median of $1,400,500.

faq.q: Do acreages in Mission sell above asking price?
faq.a: 9% of the 76 houses with acreage sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 95.6% of it.

faq.q: How old are the acreages that sold in Mission?
faq.a: The median year built was 1990 for the 76 houses with acreage sold in Mission.

faq.q: Which Mission communities sold the most acreages?
faq.a: By number sold: Mission BC (24), Mission-West (14), Dewdney Deroche (13), for November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: Is Mission a buyers’ or sellers’ market?
faq.a: In September 2026 houses in Mission had a sales ratio of 12%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market, and condos and townhomes 8%, which the reports’ scale reads as a buyers’ market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many acreages are for sale in Mission?
faq.a: The listing feed on this page shows what is active now, and the number changes daily. Ask Jared and he will send you the acreages in Mission that match what you want.
